description: This file implements the core functions for a STUN (Simple Traversal of UDP Through NATs) client, including creation, removal, enrollment of subordinate objects, and initialization routines. It contains code for managing timers, UDP objects, and internal state, as well as setting up various callback functions related to STUN operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE StunScoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new STUN Simple Client Object, initializes its base object fields, and registers core functions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates resources associated with the STUN client object, including timers and UDP objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Creates and enqueues the timer, UDP, and worker objects required for the STUN client, setting up callback functions and object references.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs the actual initialization of the object’s internal state and properties, setting up default values and callback functions.
